text:
```artifact
Decision Table for Symptom Maintenance (Requirement U13_4)

| Condition | Add Symptom | View/Update Symptom | Delete Symptom |
|-----------|-------------|---------------------|----------------|
| Symptom Exists | New Symptom | View Existing | Not Allowed |
| Symptom Used | Not Allowed | Update Existing | Not Allowed |
| Symptom Not Used | Allowed | View Existing | Allowed |

Notes:
- "Symptom Exists" refers to whether the symptom is already in the master list.
- "Symptom Used" checks if the symptom has been referenced in any Consultation Request.
- Actions are mutually exclusive for each condition combination.
```

```json
[
  {
    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Add a new Symptom",
    "req_ids": ["U13_4/1"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["No symptom with the same name exists"],
    "inputs": {"symptom_name": "Headache", "description": "Pain in the head"},
    "steps": ["Navigate to Symptom Maintenance screen", "Enter new symptom details", "Submit"],
    "expected": ["Symptom added successfully", "Symptom list updated"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-002",
    "title": "View and Update an existing Symptom",
    "req_ids": ["U13_4/2"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Symptom 'Headache' exists"],
    "inputs": {"symptom_name": "Headache", "new_description": "Sharp pain in the head"},
    "steps": ["Navigate to Symptom Maintenance screen", "Select 'Headache'", "Update description", "Submit"],
    "expected": ["Symptom description updated", "Updated description displayed"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-003",
    "title": "Attempt to Update a Symptom that has been used",
    "req_ids": ["U13_4/2"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["Symptom 'Headache' exists and has been used in a Consultation Request"],
    "inputs": {"symptom_name": "Headache", "new_description": "Dull pain in the head"},
    "steps": ["Navigate to Symptom Maintenance screen", "Select 'Headache'", "Attempt to update description", "Submit"],
    "expected": ["Update denied", "Message indicating symptom cannot be updated because it has been used"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-004",
    "title": "Delete a Symptom that has never been used",
    "req_ids": ["U13_4/3"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Symptom 'Nausea' exists and has never been used"],
    "inputs": {"symptom_name": "Nausea"},
    "steps": ["Navigate to Symptom Maintenance screen", "Select 'Nausea'", "Delete", "Confirm"],
    "expected": ["Symptom deleted", "Symptom list updated"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-005",
    "title": "Attempt to Delete a Symptom that has been used",
    "req_ids": ["U13_4/3"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["Symptom 'Headache' exists and has been used in a Consultation Request"],
    "inputs": {"symptom_name": "Headache"},
    "steps": ["Navigate to Symptom Maintenance screen", "Select 'Headache'", "Attempt to delete", "Confirm"],
    "expected": ["Delete denied", "Message indicating symptom cannot be deleted because it has been used"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-006",
    "title": "Boundary Test: Delete the last unused Symptom",
    "req_ids": ["U13_4/3"],
    "kind": "boundary",
    "preconditions": ["Only one unused symptom 'Fever' exists"],
    "inputs": {"symptom_name": "Fever"},
    "steps": ["Navigate to Symptom Maintenance screen", "Select 'Fever'", "Delete", "Confirm"],
    "expected": ["Symptom deleted", "Symptom list updated to be empty"]
  }
]
```
